Welcome to Standardpharm Co., Ltd., a premier chemical and pharmaceutical enterprise strategically headquartered at 363 East 42nd Street, New York, NY 10017. Situated in the vibrant heart of Midtown Manhattan, our prime corporate location reflects our dynamic, forward-thinking approach to the fast-paced global chemical industry. 

Standardpharm has established itself as an industry-leading manufacturer, supplier, and distributor of high-quality chemical products. We specialize in the research, development, and production of fine chemicals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and advanced chemical intermediates. Our rigorous quality control protocols and commitment to cutting-edge research ensure that every compound we produce meets the strictest international regulatory standards. We proudly serve a wide array of vital sectors, including healthcare, biotechnology, agriculture, and specialized industrial manufacturing.

At the core of Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is a relentless commitment to scientific innovation and environmental sustainability. We believe in harnessing the power of advanced chemistry to solve complex global challenges while actively minimizing our ecological footprint. Our dedicated team of world-class chemists, engineers, and researchers works tirelessly on custom synthesis and scalable green production methods, offering tailored, cost-effective solutions to meet the unique needs of our diverse clientele.

Leveraging our New York headquarters as a central global hub, we maintain a robust and highly efficient supply chain network that guarantees timely, secure delivery to partners worldwide. Whether you are a pharmaceutical giant seeking reliable wholesale API sourcing or a specialized research institution requiring bespoke chemical solutions, Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is your trusted, long-term partner. We are deeply dedicated to driving scientific advancement and building a healthier, more sustainable future through absolute excellence in chemistry.
